episode_title: #621: Quick Tip: Are you customers missing your messages?

real_qa.q: Why do text messages get customer attention faster than emails in time-sensitive situations?
real_qa.r: Text messages can get someone's attention much more quickly than emails, which can sit unread in the inbox for hours or even days. Text messages are particularly useful for time-sensitive communications like last minute appointment openings, event reminders, or offers ending soon.
real_qa.requete: text messages vs emails customer attention

real_qa.q: What are the three key things to consider when using SMS in your communication strategy?
real_qa.r: First, keep it short—a text message is not the space for a whole sales pitch, so get straight to the point about what your customer needs to know and what action you want them to take next. Second, make sure it's relevant and that your information is genuinely useful to that person, and ensure they've agreed to receiving text messages. Third, make sure you give them a clear next step, whether it's confirming an appointment, booking a slot, or clicking a link—make it super simple and easy for them to take action.
real_qa.requete: SMS text message strategy best practices

real_qa.q: What is the core principle behind effective marketing communication according to Strategy with Sally?
real_qa.r: Good marketing isn't about sending more messages. It's about sending the right message to the right person at the right time.
real_qa.requete: right message right person right time marketing
